svg.text: Layout A · plain text row: chevron, sentence-case label, muted count beside it, hairline above
Round 1, greyscale. Phone 412x915, synthetic data only. Issue #33: lighter section headers, no band.
1 · PRs at rest, empty section collapsed
40px row on the row colour, no band. Chevron at left, label
13px bold, count 13px muted right after it. A hairline above
marks each break.
Needs my review has 0 rows, so it starts closed.
2 · Mine collapsed by tap
Tapping anywhere on the Mine header closes it; the chevron
turns right. Org open moves up under it.
3 · Scrolled mid-list, Mine pinned
Mine pins under the collapsed title bar. Once pinned, a
hairline appears below it so rows sliding under stay separate.
The search bar has slid away.
4 · Issues tab at rest

g.text: Sync line shows stale API count
Order export drops the vendor id
Add retry budget to the client
Crash when the token is revoked
Docs link 404s on the help page

svg.text: Same header on Issues. Created by me (0) and All open (closed
by default) show as single lines.
5 · Every section empty
Every section empty: the empty block replaces the headers, as
on main. Four rows of 0 add nothing the message does not say.
Today on main (read from web/phone/)
Headers already collapse. SectionHeader in PhoneList.tsx is
a button with aria-expanded and a chevron (down open, right
closed). A tap toggles the section; PhoneInbox.tsx drops its
rows.
The choice is saved per section key in localStorage
(nod-phone-open, phone-collapsed.ts) and outlives reloads.
Defaults: Org open, Dependabot and All open start closed
(CLOSED_BY_DEFAULT in PhoneApp.tsx). Empty sections start
open, so "NEEDS MY REVIEW 0" shows a bare header.
resolveOpen opens the first non-empty section if none is
open.
Headers are already sticky: .ph-section is position: sticky
and pins under the collapsed title bar. They are 44px,
banded (bgColor-muted), hairline above and below, 12px
uppercase, count at far right.
When every section is empty, the empty block replaces all
headers. With a single chip selected, that section is forced
open.
Change for #33: a section with 0 rows renders closed
whatever was saved. A saved choice applies again once it has
rows. Tapping an empty header opens one muted line, "No PRs
here".
Layout A: the header reads like a line of text, so it is the quietest option and the count sits right where the eye lands after the label. The
hairline does the separating that the band used to do.
Empty section header: kept, closed, with its 0 (both layouts). A missing section reads like a load failure, the 0 says "checked, nothing waiting", and
sections stay in the same order and place every visit.
Sticky: kept (both layouts). Headers already pin on main; the pinned label answers "which section am I in" during long scrolls. Frame 3 marks the
pinned header with a dashed outline.
Setup: every frame is a 412x915 Android phone with the status bar and the bottom nav (PRs / Issues / Activity with badges). The large-title header
from #31, the sync line and the rows stay as on main. The search pill and filter button from #32 Layout A sit above the nav, undetailed, and hide on
scroll down. No chip row, as in #32.
Sections come from shared/sections.ts (Needs my review, Mine, Org open, Dependabot) and shared/issue-sections.ts (In progress, With bot when
configured, Assigned to me, Created by me, Mentioned, Untriaged, All open). Dependabot is 0 here, so it is collapsed below the fold in frames 1 and 2.
Sample data only: repos acme-co/orders-api and acme-dev/tools; authors acme-dev, build-bot and sam-lee. Greyscale labelled boxes, minimum 12px text,
no colour or styling.
